title: Every AI video tool you pay for is renting you seconds
description:
Every AI video tool you pay for is renting you seconds, and this month an open model you can download and own started shooting entire scenes, cuts, voices and all.

It's called LTX 2.5. 22 billion parameters, video and audio in one model, open weights on Hugging Face with ComfyUI support from day one. The part nobody else has: every AI clip you've made is one continuous shot, and this one cuts like a film editor. One generation goes wide, then medium, then close-up, holding the same character, the same lighting and the same voice across every cut. That's a scene, not a clip. On NVIDIA's top chips it makes 10 seconds of footage in 6.8 seconds, and you can fine-tune the model on your own footage.

The honest part: the full model won't fit a normal laptop, consumer GPUs run the smaller versions, that speed number is NVIDIA's top hardware, and the license is free only while your company makes under 10 million dollars a year.

Comment LTX and I'll send you the links.
